title: DOLE moves to shield delivery riders from heat-related penalties, perils

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Delivery riders may be protected from penalties for heat-related delays under a proposed labor advisory being drafted by the Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) to protect workers from the effects of the El Niño phenomenon and other periods of extreme heat. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino met with representatives of 13 ride-hailing, delivery and e-commerce platforms on Friday to discuss measures to prevent and manage heat stress among riders. The companies included Grab, Angkas, Foodpanda, Lalamove, Shopee, Maxim, Move It, Para Xpress Technology Services Inc., InDrive, Flash Express, Lazada, Ninja Van and Alliance of Tech Innovators for the Nation (ATIN).
